_comment: Packages this fork uses on top of what the base illogical-impulse install brings.
Read by scripts/deps/deps.py, which the setup script and Settings > About both go through.
tier 'required': installed by `ii-p3drovfx install` and `update`, after asking.
tier 'optional': never installed on its own; `ii-p3drovfx deps` or Settings > About.
A package is present when its check passes: 'bin' (any one of them on PATH or in
/usr/sbin), 'python' (importable by the system python3), or the package manager.
'name' is the package on every distro; 'arch'/'fedora' override it, null means
not packaged there. 'aur' marks an Arch package that needs yay or paru.
